name: invgate-service-desk-mcp
description: InvGate Service Desk MCP: 96 tools/11 domains, 3-tier access (none/support/full), OTel.
long_description: InvGate Service Desk MCP — 96 tools across 11 domains (incidents, users, knowledge base, assets, time tracking), read-only by default with a 3-tier write access model (none/support/full), and built-in OpenTelemetry observability.
